response.answer:
To be eligible for the Post Graduate Scholarship Scheme for GATE/GPAT Qualified Students-AICTE, candidates must meet the following criteria: they must have a valid GATE/CEED score at the time of admission, be admitted as full-time scholars, and be enrolled in an AICTE-approved M.E., M.Tech., or M.Des. program at an AICTE-approved institution or university department within the approved intake of the program. Final-year students of eligible dual-degree integrated programs may also receive the scholarship from the 9th semester for one year.

However, several exclusions apply: foreign students, sponsored candidates, and candidates admitted through management quota are not eligible. Additionally, students receiving financial assistance from another organization cannot receive the AICTE scholarship during that period, and passed-out students taking second-time admission after re-qualifying GATE/CEED who have already received an AICTE or other centrally funded institution scholarship are also not eligible.

response.answer:
The knowledge base includes the following scholarship schemes supporting girl students: 

1. Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree): Target group includes girl students pursuing a technical degree. Eligibility requires being a female student admitted to the first year of a degree course or second year through lateral entry in an AICTE-approved institution with a maximum annual family income of INR 800,000, among other regional criteria. Applications are submitted online via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

2. Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Diploma): Target group includes girl students pursuing a technical diploma. Eligibility requires being a female student admitted to the first year or second year through lateral entry of a diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution with a maximum annual family income of INR 800,000, along with regional criteria. Applications are submitted online via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).

3. Post Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship For Single Girl Child: Target group includes single girl children admitted to the first year of a regular, full-time non-professional Master's degree course. Eligibility requires being a female Indian citizen aged 30 or below at the time of admission, who is the only girl child in the family (without brothers, or twin/fraternal daughters are also eligible). Applications are submitted online through the National Scholarship Portal after notices are published on the UGC website.
